result.summary: The main visual defect is overflow/clipping of restaurant names in the Fastest near you row; other carousel/chip cutoffs at the screen edge are treated as intended.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word even though the card image is fully on screen, so the name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Constrain or wrap titles within the card width (ellipsis or two-line wrap) so names stay fully visible.
